setting.cloud_content_desc: Free effects, transitions, graphics, templates and media from the cloud. Turn it off to use only what is on this computer.
setting.cloud_url_desc: Leave empty to use the default server.
setting.cloud_url_invalid: Enter an http or https address with no ? or #.
setting.cloud_unreachable: The cloud could not be reached: showing downloaded items only
setting.crf_hint: Lower is better quality and a larger file.
setting.hardware_accel_hint: Encode on Apple's media engine. Much faster, and uses more bitrate for the same picture.
setting.prores_hint: ProRes files are very large — expect hundreds of MB per minute.
setting.no_selection: Nothing selected yet. Pick a clip on the timeline to see its options.
setting.speed_ramp_add: Double-click to add a point, right-click to remove

modal.change_language_description: If you change the language, you will have to restart the app.
modal.needs_to_restart_description: WARNING: You may lose unsaved tasks.

onboarding.welcome_subtitle: welcome to cartcut. a powerful video editor.

duration.title: Set the video length
duration.body: Change the minutes or seconds here to decide how long your video runs.

file_tab.title: Open the File tab
file_tab.body: Click the File tab to browse the media on your computer.

folder.title: Choose a folder
folder.body: Select the folder that holds your videos, images or audio.

add_file.title: Add a clip
add_file.body: Click any file to add it to the timeline at the playhead.

playhead.title: Move the playhead
playhead.body: Drag along the ruler to move the playhead through your video.

text_tab.title: Open the Text tab
text_tab.body: Click the Text tab to see the text styles.

add_text.title: Add a text
add_text.body: Click Text to add a default text clip to your timeline.

hints.open_canvas: Switch to the Canvas tab first.
hints.open_subfolder: Open a folder to find your media.
hints.no_media: No media here. Choose a folder with videos, images or audio.

adjust.reset_hint: Double-click a name to reset it.

update.available: A new version is available. Download it?
update.ready: The update is ready to install.
update.failed: The update could not be downloaded.
update.unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Restart anyway?
